title: Toosty Basics PVP
description: All in One Pack For PVP, like Low fire Low shield No explosion and anothers stuff cool
body:
A lot off tweaks for pvp of very many anothers resourepacks!
For you don't need to install a lot of resourepacks 
This Resoure pack Add:
Low Shield
low fire
Better Shield Sound
Small totem 
No Pumpkin Overlay
No Explosion
Sun and Moon better 
this is basics off pvp pack, or maybe Survivals. But normaly, dont have a resourepack whit all of this packs for pvp, and this resourepack group all in one
(Minecraft may show this resource pack as incompatible with version 1.19.4+. However, it has been tested and works correctly on 1.21.11. You can safely ignore the warning and enable the pack. But i tested only 1.21.11, maybe have bugs)
Credits:
Low Shield
Better Shield Sounds
Small Totem Pop
PvP basic
Low on fire
Vanilla tweaks
